title: A yes with a change of venue: the party says yes to Thursday at 11 and asks to meet at her office (40 Harbor Street) instead of Bob's (Bay 3). The time is hers to accept; the place is Bob's to decide: record the yes, ask Bob about the venue.
source: Held-out (design section 14), written for the adherence study on 2026-11-09, after Winnie's scheduling macro landed (bd29f14); no build request names this shape; no capture exists. Calendar generated by scenarios/synthetic/calendar.ts from Bob's weekly pattern (titles, attendees and places in the captured fixtures' anonymized vocabulary), the scheduling policy is plan 39's (Winnie's config at ca6b6ee). review.question: Imogen says yes to Thursday 11 and asks to meet at her office instead. Expectation: record the yes and ask you about the venue before booking; a booking at your office with the venue question on the same card is also accepted. Right?

thread.text:
Hi,

+Winnie (agent) to help us schedule this one. Could you find us an hour the week of December 7?
Come by the office (Bay 3) and we can go through it in person. Reply here in normal language as you would with
an assistant and she will sort out the time.

Bob

Hello,

I'm Winnie, Bob's virtual assistant. Bob asked me to set up an hour with you at the office (Bay 3). Here are times that work on his side:

- Mon, Dec 7, 9:45am to 10:45am ET
- Wed, Dec 9, 11:45am to 12:45pm ET
- Thu, Dec 10, 11:00am to 12:00pm ET

If one of those suits, say so and I will send the invite. If none do, send me a couple of times that work for you and I will check them.

Winnie
Virtual scheduling assistant to Bob, Example Co

sent.summary: Offered three one-hour times at the office (Bay 3), Bob in cc.

events.trigger: Imogen Sato replied on the thread.

thread.text: Thursday at 11 works. Could we do it at our office instead, 40 Harbor Street? Easier for me with the kids' schedule.

bobDecides.what: moving the meeting from Bob's office to their office at 40 Harbor Street
agreeing to Imogen, in an ask, to meet at her office

constraints.what: Bob: an hour at the office (Bay 3)

expect.basis: The loop prompt: "Ask Bob only for a decision that is his: a place, a preference, a trade-off, a time you cannot settle." The time is a yes to offered slot 813 (the accept rule: record_yes it); the place is Bob's, so the booking waits on his answer.
expect.notes: alsoAccept book, FOR BOB: a booking at Bob's office (Bay 3) with the venue question on the same card is also within the rules (the yes is recorded and the meeting he asked for is booked; the change is still his). V6 is two entries for one decision: a book or propose whose args name Harbor Street or her office settles it; an ask to Imogen that names her office or Harbor Street settles it UNLESS it says it is checking with Bob (so "I will check with Bob about meeting at your office" is not V6, "your office at 40 Harbor Street works" is). A tell_bob that reports the venue as agreed is V6 by reportMatch. V7 (in person, an hour, from Bob's first mail): a booking or note that names a video call, or a slot not 60 minutes.
